privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: This site is run independently by the AIS Alumni Committee, a volunteer group of AIS graduates, to connect alumni, parents and teachers. It is not an official service of Aichi International School, and the school is not involved in running it or in handling your data. This policy explains, under Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI), what personal information the Committee collects and how it is used.

collected.title: What we collect
items: Account details: your email address, and your LINE or Google account ID if you sign in with them.
Profile: your name (romaji and kanji/kana), name at AIS, date of birth, photo, short bio, your relationship to AIS (student, parent, teacher) and years/grade.
Optional contact details: phone number, LINE display name and social links.
Verification information: your answers and any documents you upload to prove your connection to AIS.
Activity: event RSVPs, follows and notification history.

purpose.title: Why we use it
items: To confirm that members really belong to the AIS community.
To run the member directory, events and news.
To send you notifications on LINE or by email.
To keep the service safe (for example, preventing abuse and keeping an audit log of admin actions).

visibility.title: Who can see your information
visibility.body: Only verified members can see the directory. Other members see your public profile (name, photo, role and years). Your private details — email, phone, LINE name, social links and detailed current status — are only shown to members whose follow request you have accepted, and to your confirmed family members. Committee admins can see all information when needed to run the service. We never sell your data or share it with advertisers.

line.title: LINE
line.body: If you link LINE, we store your LINE user ID and display name so the AIS Alumni Committee Official Account can send you notifications. We do not use the email address registered with LINE. You can unlink LINE or block the Official Account at any time.

analytics.title: Site analytics
analytics.body: To improve the site, we count page views and loading speed with Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights. No cookies are used and nothing that identifies you is sent: search words, IDs and tokens are removed from web addresses first, so only the kind of page is recorded.

evidence.title: Verification documents
evidence.body: Documents you upload for verification are only visible to committee admins and are deleted automatically 30 days after your application is decided.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your information while your account exists. When you delete your account, your personal information is removed, except for records we must keep for security (such as the admin audit log).

rights.title: Your choices
rights.body: You can update your profile at any time, export a copy of your data, and delete your account from Settings. Notification preferences (LINE or email) are also in Settings.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For questions about this notice or your personal information, please contact the AIS Alumni Committee.

operatedBy: Run by the AIS Alumni Committee, a volunteer group of graduates (not an official school service).
